name: PATCH - WF2e TikTok Ads Upsert (copy these 3 nodes into WF2e)

nodes.name: Read existing TikTok ad rows
nodes.notes: UNFORMATTED_VALUE + SERIAL_NUMBER means Date comes back as a serial number and Ad_ID as whatever it really is (string OR number). The Code node normalises both. If this read fails nothing is written for the brand -- error output goes to the alert node.

nodes.name: Plan TikTok ad row writes
nodes.notes: Returns one item carrying the whole batchUpdate payload plus counters (updated / appended / existing_duplicates / numeric_ids_repaired). Log those counters: existing_duplicates > 0 means the sheet still has duplicated ad-days from before this patch was installed.

nodes.name: Write TikTok ad rows
nodes.notes: RAW is the whole point: Google stores exactly what we send, so the Ad_ID string is never re-parsed as a 16-digit number. Explicit row numbers make a retry safe -- the same rows are rewritten, not appended.

_patch.target_workflow: WF2e TikTok Scheduled Report Email Import (Raw Only) FIXED
_patch.rewire: Explode ad rows  ->  Read existing TikTok ad rows  ->  Plan TikTok ad row writes  ->  Write TikTok ad rows  ->  (whatever Upsert Daily_Raw_TikTok_Ads was connected to)
